name: Daiobake Yashiki ~Hamamura Jun no Jitsuwa Kaidan~
original_name: 大幽霊屋敷 ～浜村 淳の実話怪談～
source:
Daiobake Yashiki - Hamamura Jun no Jitsuwa Kaidan is a horror adventure game that features Jun Hamamura as the hoster and the haunted mansion manager in which the player enters to work as a part time job in the summer. The game features 41 ghost stories that will advance in visual novel style during the game some voice narrated and some in text format with images, and there are also a couple of mini games that will happen in some parts of the advanture. The game also features other japanese actors like Junichi Osako, Tomomi Fujisawa, Keisuke Takagi and is directed by Yamada Seiwa.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/D/SLPS-02160.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
Daiobake Yashiki - Hamamura Jun no Jitsuwa Kaidan是一款恐怖冒险游戏，以Hamamura Jun为主人，同时也是鬼屋经理，玩家在夏天进入其中打工。该游戏有41个鬼故事，游戏过程中将以视觉小说风格推进，有些是语音叙述，有些是带有图像的文本格式，并且在冒险的某些部分还会发生一些小游戏。该游戏还由大迫纯一、藤泽智美、高木圭介等其他日本演员出演，由山田清和执导。

[来自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/D/SLPS-02160.html]Psxdatacenter[/url]]
